text:
Box CEO @levie's defense of software over vibe-coded, n-of-1 internal tools:

"If you're Ford, and you're doing your supply chain on an ERP system, you want that to work the exact same way every single time."

"The billions of transactions going through that ERP system, you cannot take for granted. So the idea that you're going to go vibe-code that is not possible, or at least not likely."

"The other point is: your company has a fixed amount of IT resources. And you have to decide what you're going to spend your time on as an organization." 

"Do you want to spend time on rebuilding something that the market can supply you, that's seen best practices thousands of times? Or do you want to go and build that out with your n-of-1 experience?" 

"Or do you want to spend your limited, scarce resources on building software, and building experiences, that will make you more money, and that will actually be used by your customers?"

"I think on the margin the average enterprise is going to spend their time and energy on the latter."

"I'm 100% bullish on vibe-coding, 100% bullish that we're going to have 100x more software. But that still doesn't cross the threshold where I would want to go build our own CRM system."

text:
BREAKING Announcements by @splunk Team! Front row at .conf 2025. I just stepped out of the Product Keynote. The story is simple. Open data, agentic AI, and one flow from issue to fix.

Platform

•Splunk Federated Search for Snowflake: Query Snowflake from the Splunk interface and join it with Splunk data for richer context.

•Unlimited onboarding: add Snowflake as a source without heavy ETL.

•Federated queries: use SPL-like searches on Snowflake directly from Splunk.

•Efficient execution: let Snowflake run the heavy compute and finish the join in Splunk.

Observability

•Agentic AI for proactive ops

•AI-Directed Troubleshooting in Observability Cloud and AppDynamics identifies likely root cause fast.

•Event iQ and ITSI Episode Summarization group alerts and explain impact, trends, and probable cause.

•Observability for AI

•AI Agent Monitoring tracks quality and cost of LLMs and agents.

•AI Infrastructure Monitoring watches health and consumption to control spend.

•Unified experience across AppDynamics and Observability Cloud

•Business Insights ties app performance to checkout, loans, and supply chain flows.

•Digital Experience Analytics gives product and design deeper user behavior signals with faster setup.

•APM support expands for hybrid apps and business transactions.

•Session Replay for Browser and Mobile in AppDynamics, now extended to Observability Cloud.

•AppDynamics Agent on OpenTelemetry collects once and routes to AppDynamics or Observability Cloud.

•RUM with ThousandEyes correlates user experience with network performance.

Why this matters for enterprise leaders

•Faster detection and resolution, clearer business impact, more predictable cost.

•Open data posture reduces lock-in and keeps analytics close to the system of record.

•A single experience helps platform, SRE, and product teams move together.

My analysis

•Federated Search for Snowflake is the right bridge. Keep data where it is clean and cheap. Use Splunk for correlation and action.

•Agentic AI only lands if explanations and approvals are visible. The focus on summaries and directed troubleshooting pushes in that direction.

•The most important shift is language. Observability is speaking in business flows like checkout and loans. That is how you earn executive time.

•Watch three things next. Real-world latency at scale, cost curves for federated patterns, and migration clarity for AppDynamics and Splunk estates.

How this helps the community

•Practitioners lose the swivel chair and gain time to fix root causes.

•Platform teams can standardize on open pipelines and keep the budget steady.

•Leaders get outcomes they can report: MTTD, MTTR, incident count, change failure rate, cost per GB.

Stay tuned for more interviews!!!!

Thanks to amazing speakers, Jeetu Patel, Kamal Hathi, Mangesh Pimpalkhare, Patrick Lin, Mike Horn, Tom Gillis, Lizzy Li and many more!!!!
